synthesizedFacts.fact: Forehead acne is primarily caused by clogged pores due to excess oil, dead skin cells, and bacteria.
Hormonal changes, particularly during puberty, menstruation, and stress, can increase sebum production and lead to forehead acne.
Hair products and habits, such as using pomades or not washing hair frequently, can contribute to forehead acne.
Face mapping, an ancient practice, suggests that acne in specific facial areas may indicate internal health issues, but lacks scientific evidence.
